Oops: `["set", rows[2][0], 20]` sets a filler route (hop 7 → 20), which explodes the run count to 3403 ✓ correct invalid behavior.

Let me change the transaction to set a route to hop 7 (same as filler) or erase a filler route → keeps R small. Actually to make it slightly interesting: set the special route (rows[1]) to hop 7 → R shrinks.

Let me use tx = [[["set", rows[1][0], 20]]] (rows[1] is the first special route with hop 3).

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && sed -i 's/tx=\[\[\["set",rows\[2\]\[0\],20\]\] for _ in range(7)\]/tx=[[[["set","::\/0",20]]] for _ in range(7)]/' tmp/mkscale.py && sed -i "s/tx=\[\[\[\"set\",rows\[2\]\[0\],20\]\] for _ in range(7)\]/tx=[[[\"set\",rows[1][0],20]] for _ in range(7)]/" tmp/mkscale.py && timeout 120 python3 tmp/mkscale.py fullbatch 5 > tmp/scale_full.json && python3 -c "
import sys,json; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from protocol import parse_request
import fib
cases=parse_request(open('/workspace/tmp/scale_full.json').read().encode())
print('R per case',[[len(s) for s,_ in fib.publish(c['initial'],c['transactions'])] for c in cases])
print('TOTAL R',sum(len(s) for c in cases for s,_ in fib.publish(c['initial'],c['transactions'])))
" && time python3 -B submission/main.py < tmp/scale_full.json > tmp/scale_full.out && python3 -c "

import light
req=json.load(open('/workspace/tmp/scale_full.json')); out=json.load(open('/workspace/tmp/scale_full.out'))
print([c['objective'] for c in out['cases']])
light.check(req,out,samples=8); print('LIGHT OK fullbatch')
